title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v9.12 -> Cool Edit Pro v.20 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by a smoking Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain and a tight Day Job, with pristine patching of minor cuts.
ai_review.review: The recording is a very clean SBD with expertly patched gaps, letting the band’s groove shine from the first minute of Shakedown Street through an energetic Day Job. The second‑set climax – Scarlet Begonias into Fire on the Mountain – is described as a rare moment where precision and beauty meet absolute perfection.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (5★ and 4★) and praised the musical performance and soundboard quality; with only two detailed reviews confidence is limited.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced SBD; reviewers note very nice quality and commendable patching of a few cuts, no major dropouts or muffiness reported.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Groove locks in quickly on Shakedown Street, maintains high energy through Day Job, and peaks with a precision‑driven Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain sequence in the second set.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland receives explicit praise for his keyboard work, especially on Day Job.
